_doc: Large batch L05 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to builder defaults.

moss-golem/f:b1.note: spore burst = a soft spore cloud; keeps leaf for the creeper whip only

moss-golem/f:u0.note: boulder fist = a stone punch, no tag but the art is a rock fist

lichen-golem/f:b0.note: tendril = a creeping vine-like strand; lichen crust is plant growth

lichen-golem/f:b1.note: grey dust puff: the name says puff, dust cloud over a slash

coral-golem/f:b1.note: anemone sting = trailing tentacle strands (best guess, poison family already used by u2)

coral-golem/f:x0.note: a coral stack crumbling down = rubble thump, not a slash

coral-golem/f:u1.note: anemone sways under water: ripples beat plain puff for a coral creature

giant-bumblebee/f:b3.note: drone dart on a swarm critter: buzzing dots instead of shock zigzag

giant-bumblebee/f:x0.note: name says Buzzing; swarm critter bulk drone

giant-bumblebee/f:u0.note: a bumble bump is a body slam, not a slash

giant-bumblebee/f:u2.note: pollen puff: the name says puff; trip is minor (best guess)

lichen-reindeer/f:b0.note: cloven hoof = a stomp, not a streak

lichen-reindeer/f:b1.note: lichen-crusted antlers shed flakes; avoids a twin of Antler Sweep (best guess)

red-stag/f:b1.note: a snort = a breath of steam puffs

red-stag/f:u0.note: autumn rut = antler clash, the heaviest hit of the stag (no keyword; best guess)

red-stag/f:u2.note: art line names autumn bracken: leaf fronds hide the dodge

red-stag/f:u3.note: a rut call is a bellow: sound rings, not a snare (trick/trip default web)

gorse-beast/f:x0.note: shaggy heap crash = a heavy slump

gorse-beast/f:u0.note: gorse flare: yellow bloom burst flares like a flame; art beats bash tag (best guess)

peat-golem/f:b1.note: peat dust cloud: the name says dust puff

peat-golem/f:x0.note: a stack of peat collapsing = rubble thump

peat-golem/f:u1.note: bog fist: wet mud flung off the trip; avoids a plain slash (best guess)
